text.description_html:
Acorn WTRBI, Double Cylinder 13-1/2" Warwick Lockset

Double cylinder handlesets are most often used on doors with windows or that are located near windows because you need a key to unlock it from both the outside and the inside. The mounts and the deadbolt rose of the Double Cylinder 13-1/2" Warwick Mortise Handleset feature an old world design that will grant a feeling of antiquity to any door--making it perfect for restoration projects. This along with the rough black iron finish of the Warwick Handleset duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered of iron. The Warwick black iron handleset is good for doors with 1-3/4" - 2-1/2" thicknesses and 2-3/4" backsets.

Unlike a simple tubular latch, this is a mortise lock. They are extremely durable and have a tighter clearance tolerance. You know it's a mortise lock when you hear that heavy, smooth, solid 'click' when the door closes shut.

Double Cylinder Handleset: The deadbolt is operated by a key from both the exterior and the interior. The latch is operated by a thumbpiece from both the exterior and the interior.

Also Available Matching:
13-1/2" Warwick Double Dummy Cylinder Handleset
13-1/2" Warwick Single Cylinder Mortise Handleset

Features of the Double Cylinder 13-1/2 Inch Warwick Mortise Handleset:

  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Heavy gauge plated steel mortise case.
  • Anti-friction brass latch bolt.
  • The deadbolt is made of brass with hardened steel inserts.
  • Package Includes: interior and exterior handle, exterior and interior cylinder, and all necessary mounting hardware.
  • Lifetime Finish Warranty

Specification for the Acorn WTRBI Mortise Handleset:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Exterior and Interior Cylinder Rose Length: 2-7/8"
  • Exterior and Interior Cylinder Rose Width: 2-1/8"
  • Exterior and Interior Handle Length: 13-1/2"
  • Exterior and Interior Handle Width: 3-1/4"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" Standard, Optional up to 2-1/2" thick doors
  • Backset: 2-3/4"
  • Mortise: 8” x 1-1/4”
  • Case: 6” x 3-5/8” x 15/16”
  • Latch Bolt: 3/4” throw
  • Deadbolt: 1” throw
  • Strike: 4-7/8” ASA
  • Thumb Turn Hubs: 3/16” on the diamond.
